definitions.gloss: to speak to, to address, to start a conversation with
definitions.explanation: To initiate speech with someone; to address or talk to someone (often unexpectedly or as the first interaction).

examples.japanese: ⟦{見知|みし}らぬ→見知らぬ：27980_mishiranu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{話|はな}しかけられた。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{話|はな}しかける⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I didn't have the courage to speak to her.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やさしく→やさしい：02640_yasashii⟧{話|はな}しかけた。
examples.english: I spoke gently to the baby.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}った→迷う：02426_mayou⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{話|はな}しかけた。
examples.english: I was lost, so I spoke to someone nearby.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}し→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦そう→そう：01167_sou⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{話|はな}しかける⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やめた→やめる：00909_yameru⟧。
examples.english: They looked busy, so I decided not to speak to them.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive).

COMPOUND VERB: ⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to speak) + ⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to initiate action toward)

CONJUGATION (ichidan): {話|はな}しかける → {話|はな}しかけない → {話|はな}しかけた → {話|はな}しかけて

PATTERN: 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{話|はな}しかける (speak to ~)

NUANCE: Emphasizes the act of initiating conversation, rather than simply talking. Often implies the other person wasn't expecting to be addressed.

The 〜かける pattern indicates the beginning of an action directed toward someone/something.
